scope: All 100 residual každy-family universal and distributive pronouns in live v019 Latin sources, all in papers 1-43 and spread across 76 lines.
choice: Normalize the complete family to the reader's established official vśaky paradigm in house spelling vsak-, using an exact inflection-aware 19-form map.
motivation: All sites mean each or every. Although both lemmas are official type 1, the isolated každy layer is West-and-East shaped and explicitly negative in several South comparators, while vśaky preserves East and West recognition and directly matches South vsak/svaki. The reader already had 1,232 vsak-family tokens, so this removes a 100-token source-stratum split instead of expanding it.
alternatives_rejected: Retain both official synonyms: this leaves a semantically empty source-layer split and a South-negative enclave.
Normalize the established 1,232 vsak-family sites to každy: this creates far larger churn and worsens South-Slavic recognition.
Map the family to vse/vsi: that changes distributive quantification and can alter agreement and scope.
Blindly replace the stem: that leaves malformed or non-house forms such as každome and každų instead of repairing them to vsakom and vsaku.

entries.id_937: každy, adjective type 1, each/every; positive BE/CS/PL/RU/SK/UK but negative BG/HR/SL/SR
entries.id_4326: vśaky, adjective type 1, each/every; positive BG/CS/HR/RU/SR/UK and approximate PL/SK, with South national comparators vsak/svaki
entries.id_13864: vśaky, type 1, every kind/either/whatever, further confirming the family's breadth

independent_math_comparators.west: A Czech mathematical control uses the každ- family.
independent_math_comparators.south: Independent Slovene and Bosnian mathematical controls use vsak-/svak-.
independent_math_comparators.east: The bounded Belarusian mathematical control abstains; official Russian, Belarusian, and Ukrainian dictionary comparators preserve East recognition for vśaky.
independent_math_comparators.inference: The vsak- bridge retains West recognition while materially improving South coverage without sacrificing East intelligibility.

live_corpus_control.semantic_finding: Every site is universal/distributive each or every; no indefinite, quoted, protected, or semantically distinct occurrence exists.
